summary: RLX Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited first-quarter 2026 financial results. The press release reports net revenues of RMB1,585.8 million ($229.9 million), up 96.2% YoY, and U.S. GAAP net income of RMB294.2 million ($42.6 million), up 32.1% YoY. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change is described. This is a routine earnings release; the filing does not trigger a special-situations category.
